AE · Other · al-meergroup.com  zoominfo.com/c/almeer/1326290906 Almeer General Contracting Establishment is a Saudi-owned company established in 2010 and headquartered in Jubail, Saudi Arabia.
They specialize in comprehensive electrical, civil construction, and mechanical erection services for industrial facilities.
The firm primarily serves large-scale sectors, including oil refineries and fertilizer plants,
